description: This PHP class 'EmbeddedURLForDailymotion' provides functionality to validate and convert Dailymotion URLs into embedded video URLs. It extends an abstract class and includes methods to match URLs against specific regex patterns, extracting video IDs to create embed URLs, with error handling for invalid URLs.

classes.name: EmbeddedURLForDailymotion
classes.description: A class responsible for generating embedded Dailymotion video URLs from standard URLs, validating URL formats, and extracting video IDs.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Returns an embedded Dailymotion URL if the input URL is valid and matches expected patterns; throws an exception otherwise.
